name: CRUD
description: Basic INSERT, SELECT, UPDATE, DELETE operations

setup_sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS bench_accounts (id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), balance DECIMAL(15,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 1000.00, name STRING NOT NULL, region STRING NOT NULL DEFAULT 'us-east', created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(), updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now())

operations.name: insert
sql: INSERT INTO bench_accounts (id, name, balance, region) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4)

operations.name: select
sql: SELECT name, balance FROM bench_accounts WHERE id = $1

operations.name: update
sql: UPDATE bench_accounts SET balance = balance + $1, updated_at = now() WHERE id = $2
